title: Ship the refresh job, lock and SessionEnd hook with the setup instead of leaving them in a private dotfiles repo
notes: Found 2026-11-23 installing a fresh instance on a second macOS machine (Darwin 27.2, uv 0.11, pnpm 11) following syntopica AGENTS.md.

The original install's atrium-refresh, atrium-lock, atrium-synthesis, the SessionEnd refresh hook and the LaunchAgents (refresh hourly, serve-context) live in the owner's private dotfiles. A new user gets an index that never refreshes after step 6. Also: 'pnpm conversations:export' refuses an existing --output, so a naive refresh must write to a temp file with --force and move it.

AGENTS.md also does not mention the atrium-context plugin, which 'atrium doctor' warns about (prompt_hook) until installed via 'claude plugin marketplace add <atrium checkout>' + 'claude plugin install atrium-context@atrium'.
History was rewritten on 2026-11-23 to correct an author: brain defbdb7 is now 584ee6b, atrium 868c6db is now 8defdb8 and 5caa18c is now f94d189.
done_when: A 'syntopica schedule' (or documented step) installs refresh + context service + hooks + plugin from public repos, and atrium doctor is all ok on a fresh machine
result: Ship the refresh job, lock and SessionEnd hook with the setup instead of leaving them in a private dotfiles repo
evidence: syntopica schedule writes and loads dev.syntopica.atrium-refresh and dev.syntopica.atrium-context; atrium 868c6db ships bin/atrium-refresh and hooks/claude-code/session-end-refresh.sh; AGENTS.md step 9 documents the command, the SessionEnd hook and the atrium-context plugin. Verified 2026-11-23 on a throwaway instance: both jobs bootstrapped under launchd, serve-context bound its socket, the hook kickstarted the refresh, bin/atrium-refresh ran end to end with exit 0 and atrium doctor reported every check ok. Not exercised there: the plugin install commands.
